clients.question: What is Surly?
clients.answer: Surly is the One Stop Shop for banking & insurance sourcing: a marketplace connecting banks & insurers with sector experts (freelance or fixed-term/permanent). Fast, simple, effective: you post your need and receive ultra-targeted profiles with a simple, transparent model designed for speed.

clients.question: What Banking & Insurance jobs does Surly specialize in?
clients.answer: We specialize solely in banking and insurance, covering all business lines and support functions: compliance & regulation, risk, actuarial, transformation, IT/data, Business Analysis, Finance & markets, operations, Sales, Marketing, HR... Goal: to offer you profiles that truly understand your sector challenges.

clients.question: How does it differ from generalist solutions?
clients.answer: The difference is specialization. Surly is designed solely for banking & insurance: targeted profiles, pre-qualification, and interlocutors who understand your challenges. You get a relevant selection faster, without 'noise' or irrelevant profiles — for freelance as well as permanent positions.

clients.question: How does the Surly platform work?
clients.answer: You have two options: 1) Consulting Firm: our talent managers qualify your need and present 2-3 relevant profiles with full support. 2) Platform Access: you access our database of pre-qualified experts directly and manage your recruitment independently.

clients.question: How to use Surly AI to find an expert?
clients.answer: Our AI assistant analyzes your need in real-time and identifies the most relevant profiles in our database. Simply describe your search (skills, duration, mission context) and our team will get back to you as soon as possible with a selection of qualified candidates. A fast and effective way to initiate your search, available 24/7.

clients.question: What is the average time to receive profiles?
clients.answer: With platform access, you instantly access profiles via our search engine boosted by a powerful matching algorithm. With consulting support, our talent managers send you a detailed commercial proposal with skills files (CVs) of selected candidates within 48h maximum.

clients.question: Are the profiles verified?
clients.answer: Yes, all our experts are verified. Each consultant justifies at least one significant experience in the Banking or Insurance sector, validated by our team before listing.

clients.question: What are Surly's rates?
clients.answer: Access to Surly is 100% free for companies and experts alike: you can post a need, browse profiles, and chat without fees. Daily rates and salaries are displayed transparently. Surly is remunerated via a commission applied only in case of contracting (mission or recruitment).

clients.question: Are there registration fees?
clients.answer: No, registration and access to the platform are completely free for everyone (companies and consultants). No hidden fees.

clients.question: What is the guarantee in case of a problem with a consultant?
clients.answer: With our firm formula, you benefit from a replacement guarantee in case of unforeseen events. Our team ensures continuous follow-up of the mission to guarantee your satisfaction.

clients.question: What types of profiles are found on Surly?
clients.answer: Our platform covers all jobs in the banking and insurance sector: support functions (HR, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Communication, etc.), technical jobs (IT, Data, Cyber, Infrastructure, etc.), métiers regulatory jobs (Compliance, Risk, Audit, Internal Control, etc.), operational jobs (Operations, Middle Office, Back Office, etc.), and management jobs (General Management, Project Management, Transformation, etc.).

clients.question: Do you offer profiles for permanent positions?
clients.answer: Yes, Surly offers both freelance missions and permanent or fixed-term positions. Our consultants can indicate their preference and you can filter according to the desired contract type.

clients.question: What regulatory expertise is covered?
clients.answer: We cover all financial sector regulations: Basel, IFRS, Solvency, AML-CFT, GDPR, PSD, DORA, Mifid, and all requirements of European regulators (ECB, ACPR, AMF, etc.).

consultants.question: How to register on Surly?
consultants.answer: Registration takes 5 minutes on our platform. You fill in your experiences (automatic import from LinkedIn or CV), your skills and tools mastered, then you set your search criteria (Daily Rate, mobility, availability).

consultants.question: Is registration fee-paying?
consultants.answer: No, registration is 100% free for consultants. Surly is remunerated solely via a commission from client companies.

consultants.question: What are the criteria to be listed on Surly?
consultants.answer: Have at least one significant experience in Banking or Insurance. All profiles are verified by our team before validation. Not sure if you are eligible? Register: our team will quickly tell you if your profile matches.

consultants.question: Can I register if I am currently in a permanent position?
consultants.answer: Yes, you can register at any time, even while employed. You simply indicate your availability date and we contact you when opportunities match your profile.

consultants.question: What types of missions are offered?
consultants.answer: We offer freelance missions (time & materials, fixed price) and salaried positions (permanent, fixed-term). You can search for both simultaneously to maximize your opportunities.

consultants.question: How am I connected with clients?
consultants.answer: When a client searches for your profile, we contact you to verify your availability and interest. If you are selected, we organize an interview with the client.

consultants.question: What is the average duration of missions?
consultants.answer: Surly missions last on average 6 to 12 months, with renewal possibilities. Some short missions (3 months) also exist for punctual reinforcements.

consultants.question: In which regions do you offer missions?
consultants.answer: We offer missions throughout France (with a concentration in Île-de-France), as well as in Spain and Portugal via our local subsidiary. We also operate in Switzerland, Belgium, Luxembourg, and other European countries depending on needs. Partial or total teleworking is often possible depending on the missions.

consultants.question: How are my Daily Rate or Salary Expectations set?
consultants.answer: You freely set your Daily Rate (freelance) or Salary Expectations (permanent). Surly does not impose them: you keep control and can modify them whenever you want. No exclusivity. Need a benchmark? Our talent managers can help you position your rate according to the type of mission or position.

consultants.question: Does Surly ask for exclusivity?
consultants.answer: No, no exclusivity is requested. You retain total control of your career and can work with other platforms or firms simultaneously.

consultants.question: How am I paid for my missions?
consultants.answer: For freelance missions, you invoice Surly. We handle the administrative management and payment: you are paid within the agreed legal and contractual deadlines, without having to deal with the final client.

consultants.question: Can you offer me umbrella company services?
consultants.answer: Yes, if you do not have a legal structure, we can refer you to our approved umbrella company partners.

consultants.question: What is the business referral program?
consultants.answer: If you recommend a consultant or a client to Surly and this recommendation leads to a mission, you receive a commission of 3% of the generated turnover.

consultants.question: How does the business referral commission work?
consultants.answer: You share the contact of a mission to be filled at a client via our dedicated form. If the mission is signed, you receive 3% of the HT turnover for the entire duration of the first mission (under conditions).

consultants.question: Who can participate in the program?
consultants.answer: The program is open to everyone: registered consultants, former consultants, professional contacts, partners. Just register and share your recommendations.

general.question: How to contact Surly?
general.answer: You can reach us via our contact form at surly.fr/contact, by email (contact@surly.fr), or by phone. Our team replies within 24 business hours.

general.question: Where are your offices?
general.answer: Surly is based in France, with a team dedicated to supporting companies and consultants in the banking and insurance sector. We also have a subsidiary in Spain and Portugal.

general.question: Is Surly GDPR compliant?
general.answer: Yes, Surly strictly respects GDPR. Your personal data is secure and you can exercise your rights of access, rectification, and deletion at any time. Consult our Privacy Policy for more details.

general.question: Do you offer partnerships?
general.answer: Yes. We build partnerships with players in the Banking & Insurance ecosystem to provide all possible help to our community of Surlyers and so they can focus fully on the essential: their mission!
